hooks.name: Typecheck, lint and test on save
hooks.description: Runs npm run check (tsc --noEmit, eslint, vitest, verify-sources) whenever a TypeScript file is saved. Skips cleanly before the project is scaffolded.

action.command: if (Test-Path package.json) { npm run check } else { Write-Output "skipped: package.json not present yet" }
